blind.description: No text or labels are visible anywhere on the model or scene. The model is a stylized fantasy architectural piece consisting of a tall vertical stone pillar on the right with a stepped plinth base, topped by a flat, faceted hexagonal cap carved with runic fissures. A thick purple tentacle with pale pink suction cups wraps around the pillar and arches over to form the underside of a curved stone beam, terminating on the left in a low stepped scroll base. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and continuous, with no broken shards, spikes, blobs, holes, or thin floating flakes. Nothing is hovering unattached, and nothing is melted or glitched. The structure stands directly on its own two architectural feet with the undersides sitting flat on the floor; there is no added terrain slab, disc, or plinth. Materials are stylized hand-painted stone and flesh in shades of deep violet, purple, and lavender with pink suckers. There are no plain black or unpainted areas, and no flames or emissive glow.
blind.from_above: From straight above, it appears as a straight, narrow rectangular bar running horizontally across the view. On the right end is the flat hexagonal top of the pillar marked with carved fissures, which connects to the narrow stone spine of the arch and terminates at the left in a slightly flared scroll base. Because the arch curves vertically rather than horizontally, its span appears almost purely linear from directly overhead.
blind.height_vs_figure: The pillar stands roughly 9 to 9.5 ft tall, about 1.5 to 1.6 times the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure. The full structure spans approximately 10.5 ft wide (spanning just over two 5-ft grid squares), about 1.8 times the figure's height.
